title: On the Approximation Complexity of Matrix Product Operator (MPO) Born Machines
abstract: arXiv:2605.11471v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Matrix product operator Born machines (MPO-BMs) are tractable tensor-network models for probabilistic modeling, yet their approximation capabilities remain poorly understood in theory. In this paper, we characterize these capabilities from both negative and positive perspectives. As a negative result, we prove that constructing a polynomial-bond MPO-BM approximation to an arbitrary continuous target with bounded KL error is NP-hard. On the positive side, for score-based variational inference, we prove that targets satisfying a log-Sobolev inequality admit polynomial-bond MPO-BM approximations with provable KL guarantees when the loss-induced Hamiltonian is local and has a constant spectral gap. Furthermore, under the same conditions, we construct local importance-sampling estimators and prove that polynomially many local score queries suffice to preserve the KL guarantees.

translated_title: 关于矩阵乘积算符玻恩机器（MPO Born Machines）的近似复杂性
translated_abstract: 矩阵乘积算符玻恩机器（MPO-BMs）是一类易于处理的用于概率建模的张量网络模型，然而其近似能力在理论上仍缺乏深入理解。本文从负面和正面两个角度刻画了这些近似能力。作为负面结果，我们证明了为任意连续目标构造具有有界KL误差的多项式键维MPO-BM近似是NP难的。在正面结果方面，对于基于分数的变分推断，我们证明了当损失诱导的哈密顿量是局部的且具有常数谱隙时，满足对数Sobolev不等式的目标容许具有可证明KL保证的多项式键维MPO-BM近似。此外，在相同条件下，我们构造了局部重要性采样估计器，并证明了多项式数量的局部分数查询足以保持KL保证。
tldr: 本文证明了用多项式键维MPO玻恩机器近似任意连续目标是NP难的，但同时表明当损失诱导哈密顿量局部且具有常数谱隙时，满足对数Sobolev不等式的目标可获得带可证明KL保证的多项式键维MPO-BM近似，且多项式数量的局部分数查询足以维持这些保证。
en_tdlr: This paper proves that constructing polynomial-bond MPO Born machine approximations with bounded KL error for arbitrary continuous targets is NP-hard, while showing that targets satisfying a log-Sobolev inequality admit provable KL-guaranteed polynomial-bond approximations when the loss-induced Hamiltonian is local with a constant spectral gap, with polynomially many local score queries sufficing to preserve these guarantees.
